answer: Vessel-Usage Register.** An agent identity must own a physical wharf slot booked under its name, and each slot logs continuous occupancy on a public ledger. A new slot requires a prior holder to sign off after a 30-day shared work period—so one applicant needs one distinct predecessor. Attackers must rent real dock space per identity, which scales linearly with cost, plus 30 days of labor per fake account. A side effect: idle identities decay unless renewed, so farming breaks even at a shale mine's expense. Each genuine holder also plants a lotus crop as proof of tenure, but that is cosmetic;
